questions.question:
What is (?) in the following?

24 : 126 :: 48 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is as follows:

24 : 126 → 5² - 1 : 5³ + 1 ⇒ 24 : 126

Similarly,

48 :** 344** → 7² - 1 : **7³ + 1** ⇒ 48 : **344**

So, the next term in the series will be:

7³ + 1 = 344

Hence, the correct answer is **"344".**

questions.question:
In the following question, the statements are followed by conclusions. Study the conclusions based on the given statements and select the appropriate option as your answer.

Statements:

G S ≤ I = N

Conclusions:

I. R > Q

II. R = Q

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II is true
Either conclusion I or II is true

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

G S ≤ I = N

**Conclusions:**

I. R > Q → This is one of the two possibilities derived from the statement R ≥ Q.

II. R = Q → This is the other possibility derived from the statement R ≥ Q.

Since both conclusions represent the only two possible conditions derived from the original relationship, and only one of them can be true at any given time, the relationship is known as an Either/Or case.

Either conclusion I or II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.

questions.question:
The question given below, two statements I & II have been given. Analyze and answer whether the data provided in the two statements are sufficient to answer the question or not.

It is 7:00 pm, when can Dipali get the next bus from Noida to Delhi?

I. Buses for Delhi leave after every 30 minutes, until 11 pm.

​II. 20 minutes ago, a bus has left for Delhi.

options.text: Statement I alone is sufficient, but statement II alone is not sufficient
Statement II alone is sufficient, but statement I alone is not sufficient
Data in both the statements together are not sufficient,
Both statement I and statement II together are needed,

questions.solution:
According to the question,

**Statement I: **Buses for Delhi leave after every 30 minutes, until 11 pm.

Here, no information regarding last bus timing from Noida is given, therefore statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

**Statement II: **20 minutes ago, a bus has left for Delhi.

Here, last bus timing is 6:40 pm (7:00 pm - 20 min) for Delhi but frequency of the bus cannot be determined, therefore statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

**Combining statement I and II: **Buses for Delhi leave after every 30 minutes, until 11 pm. 20 minutes ago, a bus has left for Delhi.

Last bus timing from Noida was 6:40 pm and as buses leave after every 30 minute. Thus the next bus would be at 7:10 pm (6:40 pm + 30 min).

∴** Both statement I and statement II together are needed to answer the question.**

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following pair is not a prime number?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 161, 163 → 161 is divisible by 7. (7 × 23 = 161)
 
• 101, 103 → 101, and 103 are prime numbers.
 
• 191, 193 → 191, and 193 are prime numbers.
 
• 41, 43 → 41, and 43 are prime numbers.

Hence, '161, 163' is the correct answer.
